questions.question: What does chapter 3 mainly describe?
options: A long prayer confessing all the many sins of the nation
A great battle fought against the enemies outside the city
A census listing each of the families who had returned
The various builders repairing sections of the wall and its gates
questions.answer: The various builders repairing sections of the wall and its gates

questions.question: Who built the Sheep Gate at the start of the chapter?
options: Nehemiah together with his own personal servants
Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests
The Levites who carried the ark of the covenant
Sanballat and the men from the region of Samaria
questions.answer: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests

questions.question: People repaired the wall each near their own house or section.
The nobles of the _____ would not stoop to serve in the work.
Many gates were rebuilt, including the Fish Gate and the _____ Gate.
